The quotation is about transferring fire and rescue authority functions to elected Mayors through a devolution bill — this is fundamentally about intergovernmental relations and the structure/scope of subnational government.

Specific mechanism: reassignment of public service (fire & rescue) governance from existing authorities to regional Mayors via legislation.

- **H7** (State and Local Government • Intergovernmental Relations) is the primary fit — it directly concerns the reallocation of governmental functions between levels/types of authority.
- **H1** (Structure and Scope of Government) is also relevant as a secondary dimension — the statement concerns which tier of government performs which function.
